name: Evafresh Bleach
shortDescription: Whitens laundry and cleans toilets, sinks and tiles.
description: Evafresh Bleach whitens white laundry and helps remove stains from toilets, sinks, tiles and drains. Always dilute and use in a well-ventilated room.
ingredients: [PLACEHOLDER] Add the ingredient list and concentration exactly as printed on your label.
howToUse: Laundry: dilute in a bucket of water before adding white clothes. Never pour directly onto fabric.
Toilets: pour under the rim, leave for 10 minutes, then scrub and flush.
Surfaces: dilute, wipe, then rinse with clean water.

dilution.ratio: [PLACEHOLDER] e.g. 1 part bleach to 10 parts water

safety: Keep out of reach of children. Never mix with acids, toilet cleaners or stain remover — dangerous gases can be released. Use in a well-ventilated area. Wear gloves. Not for coloured fabrics.

faqs.q: Can I use bleach with Stain Remover?
faqs.a: No. Never mix bleach with Stain Remover or any acid-based cleaner. Use one product, rinse thoroughly, and only then use another.
